title: Parse IPv4 Header
shortDescription: Parse raw IPv4 header bytes into structured fields with strict validation.

objectives: Parse raw IPv4 header bytes into structured fields with strict validation

hints.nudge: The header length field is measured in a different unit from the buffer length.
hints.approach: Validate version, header length, and packet bounds before reading optional header bytes. Decode network-order fields explicitly rather than relying on host layout.

templates.notes: Keep field extraction explicit; avoid undefined behavior from misaligned casts.

visibleCases.name: parse basic tcp header
visibleCases.displayExpect:
rc = 0
out.version = 4
out.ihl = 5
out.total_length = 60
out.identification = 0x1C46
out.flags = 2
out.fragment_offset = 0
out.ttl = 64
out.protocol = 6
out.header_checksum = 0xB1E6
out.src_addr = 0xC0A8010A  // 192.168.1.10
out.dst_addr = 0x08080808  // 8.8.8.8

visibleCases.name: reject non-ipv4
reject invalid ihl
visibleCases.explanation: IHL must be at least 5 (20 bytes).
